name: Hoshizuki Kotarou
source:
Kotarou represents the Libra. He is the school nurse who had ambitions to become a doctor. His father is the chairman of the academy, but after his father's retirement, the position was given to Kotarou's sister, Koharu. However, he ended up obtaining the position due to Koharu's wish to work overseas.

[Based on [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starry_Sky#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]

Kotarou represents the Libra. He is the school nurse who had ambitions to become a doctor. His father is the chairman of the academy, but after his father's retirement, the position was given to Kotarou's sister, Koharu. However, he ended up obtaining the position due to Koharu's wish to work overseas.
